answer: A simultaneous harbor ceremony stops farms: each identity sounds a key-signed echo in a 60-second window, sealed in a walnut shell with key and beacon value. The harbor board times each echo, so one operator sounds one. Each echo costs 40 credits plus a 70-credit bond, so 1,000 fakes pay 110,000 against a 40,000 pool. Shared keys, shells, or timing burn both bonds, breaking rented hands. An honest agent pays 40 credits once, keeps its bond.
